modules.title: CCure Policy Pro
modules.description: Responsible for your organisation's security policies and controls, and for the baseline — which controls apply, with what parameters — that the other products assess against.

modules.title: CCure Audit
modules.description: Responsible for finding and assessing your assets: network and web scanning, vulnerability and configuration audits, compliance against frameworks, remediation tracking and reports.

modules.title: CCure Rank
modules.description: Responsible for scoring and ranking your organisation's security posture from the results the other products produce.

modules.title: CCure IR
modules.description: Responsible for incident response: recording and managing security incidents, and feeding what is learned back to the other products.
